notes: Twenty main physical lines, five raised insertion groups and about three marginal lines were read. Handwritten Corollaire 3 asserts that for the indicated finite-type schemes and exterior extensions, equality of the induced exterior morphisms implies f=g. The next paragraph claims the formulation with abelianized kernels suffices and starts an unfinished explanation using anabelian hypotheses. This summary does not correct the mathematics. Preserve short X-Y, X=Y and prose =. The underlined word is extensions, against both witnesses. The addition reads tt court!, and grâce à replaces struck par. Final de is better than être but remains doubtful; no continuation is supplied. Script E is consistent locally. The entire marginal block is cancelled: retain every C doubt and mark the suggested edge itself uncertain rather than asserting clean diagram topology. Thin bottom-left 29 is foliation, not securely authorial; retain margin rather than mspage. No other page, other reader output, OCR, external research or TeX compilation was used. The independent crop reading changes the shared-witness tt before morphisme to a quantifier-like sign, retained as forall/A; it does not change the universal meaning of the sentence. It removes a comma falsely attributed to the raised Y, adds local uncertainty in two cancellations and the word after ont, resolves soient from its i-dot, and narrows the last word to de/des without completing the sentence.
